newsitem.title: USA: ITC to investigate complaint by Atmel.
newsitem.headline: ITC to investigate complaint by Atmel.

text.p: The U.S. International Trade Commission Wednesday voted to investigate a complaint by Atmel Corp that Japanese and Taiwanese companies were selling products in the United States that infringe on Atmel patents.
Atmel named Sanyo Electric Co. Ltd of Japan, Winbond Electronics Corp of Taiwan and Macronix International and Macronix, Inc of San Jose, Calif., in the complaint.
The company alleged that Sanyo, Winbond and Macronix are unfairly competing in the U.S. semiconductor market by selling products that infringe on four U.S. patents owned by Atmel.
The ITC said the case has been referred to an ITC administrative law judge and that it will set a target date for completion of the investigation within 45 days.
